styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small bollard-style exit sign: a round cap, a grey post, and a numbered '2' panel in orange. Its measured visible tones per tile are 12, matching kiosk-a (12) and above bus-shelter-a (6), though below vending-a (20). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no large flat fills, and the cap and post carry several grey steps with a highlight side and a shadow side. The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is tinted (dark blue-grey) rather than black, matching the references. As a thin single-tile prop it is sparse, but by eye it is not flatter or more sticker-like than the shipped references, so a careful artist would accept it beside them.
